method: Static inspection of v102 build source ID handling and edge provenance; deterministic counterexample with two distinct original parts sharing the same sourceId. No original SHP bytes or nationwide feature execution.
finding: v102 accepts duplicate nonempty sourceId values for distinct input parts. Edges preserve sourceId and vertex indices but not part index; sourceId/startVertex/endVertex alone therefore need not uniquely identify the original feature. Provenance-based per-feature audit or deduplication must not assume uniqueness. This does not establish any duplicate in the national originals.
